name: Waldorf Astoria Chengdu
positioning: A 52-story Waldorf Astoria tower in Chengdu's Financial City business zone, with Sichuanese fine dining and skyline views
best_for: Travelers with business in Chengdu's Financial City
Food lovers who want refined Sichuanese cooking without leaving the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is in the Chengdu Financial City zone in South Chengdu.
The hotel rises 52 stories above the Financial City district.
The hotel is close to Jiaozi Park and the in99 shopping mall.
The hotel is a ten-minute walk from Financial City North metro station on Line 1.
Each room has a concierge cabinet, brass and walnut finishes, and a marble bathroom with a soaking tub and twin vanities.
Bathrooms are stocked with Aesop products.
Brasserie 99 is a European-style bistro serving Western and Sichuanese food, including small hot pots and street foods.
Limited Edition Grill is an American grill styled by designer Jeffrey Beers, with a show kitchen.
Infinite Luck has four private dining rooms.
The fitness center has sauna, steam, ice and salt rooms.
The Waldorf Astoria Spa uses Valmont products for its treatments.
A personal concierge plans custom excursions and handles special requests.

highlights.text: Infinite Luck, the 50th-floor Sichuanese restaurant led by chef Tony Yang, was selected for the Michelin Guide in 2026.
Peacock Alley serves the Waldorf afternoon tea, including the signature Red Velvet Cake, to live piano.
A heated indoor pool on the 48th floor overlooks the city skyline.
The Limited Edition Sip bar pours craft cocktails with 52nd-floor city views.
Rooms look over the city, the park or the Twin Towers of Financial City, which put on a light show at night.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the Financial City business zone in South Chengdu; the nearest metro, Financial City North on Line 1, is a ten-minute walk.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing at the higher end of Chengdu's hotel market.
